goal: lock the one-shot t46 codemod to dry-run and prove the t29 accident left no residue

behaviorChange.before: no args = WRITE mode; `--check` was the only dry run; exit 1 meant 'nothing changed'
behaviorChange.after: no args = DRY RUN (zero writes); `--apply` is required to write; dry exit 0 = nothing pending, 1 = something would change; apply exit 0 = applied cleanly, 1 = fixup failure
behaviorChange.extra: --dir <path> lets the codemod run against a copy, which is how --apply was proven without touching the repo

why.incident: on 2026-10-21 r2t4 ran t46 in write mode and it deleted one character (a blank line) from t29-flag-stagger-readback.mjs
why.stillLive: under the OLD code, a fresh run reports t29 changed=true, removedChars=1 even though the file matches HEAD, because the `\n{3,}` normalisation ran on every target regardless of whether a gate block was removed
why.fix: the fixups, import rewriting and blank-line normalisation now run only when at least one removal matched; a file with nothing to remove is reported ALREADY MIGRATED and skipped, so a run can no longer dirty an already-migrated file

treeStatus.note: The tree is not empty because other members left evidence artifacts uncommitted. None of them is a codemod target and none was touched here; deleting them to make the status empty would destroy other members' work.
